page: Amazon Web Services g5.24xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance powered by the AWS Nitro hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 AMD EPYC 7R32 processor running at 3.3 GHz, with 48 physical cores and hyper-threading enabled. The hardware configuration includes 384.0 GB of DDR4 memory operating at 3 GHz, 3800 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, and a baseline network bandwidth of 50 Gbps. Acceleration is driven by four NVIDIA Ampere A10G GPUs providing a total of 89 GB of VRAM.

Benchmark data reveals a clear performance profile. While single-core CPU performance is relatively weak, ranking in the bottom 10% on stress-ng tests, the instance excels in parallelized and accelerated workloads. It achieves top-tier status in LLM inference, delivering exceptional prompt processing speeds across small, medium, and large models, as well as strong text generation throughput. Multi-core CPU performance, software compilation, and cryptography tests rank in the top 25%, supported by strong memory bandwidth for small cached blocks.

From a resource density perspective, the g5.24xlarge offers a highly qualitative balance of dense GPU acceleration, local NVMe storage, and high-vCPU compute. This makes it highly efficient for workloads that can offload intensive computations to the GPUs rather than relying on single-threaded CPU speed. It is optimized for large language model inference, ray tracing, image processing, and high-throughput cryptographic operations.
